claims.evidence: Seller's personal situation and urgency cannot be seen in any photo.

claims.claim: Item includes a 'center table' as well as the TV console
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a TV stand/wall unit with a TV on top; no center table appears in the observations.

claims.claim: TV shown is included in the sale
claims.evidence: Photo shows a TV on the stand, but witness notes it is unclear whether the TV is part of the sale.

risks.risk: Hidden damage to wood surface (scratches, water marks, chips) on sides not visible
risks.proof: Photos of all exterior sides and top surface in good light
risks.if_unproven: priced as having visible wear/damage on unseen sides

risks.risk: Interior condition of cupboard compartments (stains, mold, broken shelves)
risks.proof: Photo with cupboard doors open showing interior
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown/possible interior damage

risks.risk: Structural integrity of joints and overall stability
risks.proof: Short video showing the unit being gently shaken or pushed
risks.if_unproven: priced as structurally unverified, worst-case wobble risk

risks.risk: Exact dimensions unknown, may not fit buyer's space
risks.proof: Photo with tape measure against the unit or stated measurements
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard/generic size, buyer assumes fit risk

risks.risk: Glass or shelf edge damage not visible from current angle
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each shelf edge and any glass panels
risks.if_unproven: priced as if edges/glass may be chipped or cracked

risks.risk: Mismatch between seller's claim of 'center table' and witness's single-item observation
risks.proof: Additional photo clearly showing a separate center table alongside the TV console
risks.if_unproven: priced as single TV stand/wall unit only, center table excluded

proof_requests: Clear photos of all four sides and top of the TV stand in good lighting
Photo with cupboard doors open showing interior condition
Short video showing stability (gentle push/shake test)
Measurement photo (tape measure against the unit) or stated dimensions
Separate clear photo of the 'center table' if it is actually included
Clarification and photo confirming whether the TV itself is part of the sale
response.reason: The witness confirms a TV stand/wall unit exists, so it can be priced at worst case for an unverified-condition piece, but the seller's claim of an included center table is not supported by the photo and must be excluded until proven.
